name: Café Lermoos
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy café in Lermoos with homemade strudel variations, aromatic coffee, and a snug sun terrace.
beschreibung: The Café Lermoos in Lermoos in the Außerfern region is the perfect destination for anyone looking for a cozy break from everyday life. In this lovingly furnished café, guests enjoy a diverse range of coffee specialties, homemade cakes, and light snacks. Traditional Austrian coffee house culture is cultivated here with great passion. Especially popular are the creamy Verlängerter and the smooth Melange. In addition, fresh pastries from the in-house patisserie are offered daily. The relaxed atmosphere and cordial service make the café a popular meeting place for locals and visitors alike.
